verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Beneath the surface
Of my anxious imagination

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Beckons a calmness
That is found in you alone

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
It washes over every doubt, every imperfection
Jesus your presence is the comfort of my soul

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
There's nowhere I'd rather be
When you're singing over me
I just wanna be here with you

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I'm lost in your mystery
I'm found in your love for me
I just wanna be here with you

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Here in the waiting
I won't worry about tomorrow

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
No need to focus
On the things I can't control

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
All my attention
On the wonder of this moment
Jesus your presence is the comfort of my soul

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
So let all that I am
Be consumed with who you are

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Oh the glory of your presence
What more could I ask for
